title: Henry VII to Lamine Yamal: how?
description: Holbein's Whitehall mural, a 1570 Reformation woodcut, the line of popes and two 2026 photos link King Henry VII to Lamine Yamal.
hook: How's Henry VII linked to Lamine Yamal?
fun_fact: Holbein's original Whitehall mural burned with the palace in 1698; it survives only through the copy Remigius van Leemput painted for Charles II in 1667.
research_note: Real people only: Henry VII has no photo, so he comes in through Holbein's Whitehall mural (Leemput's 1667 copy) and Foxe's 1570 woodcut of Henry VIII with Pope Clement VII; the line of popes runs 49 holders to Leo XIV, who met King Felipe in Madrid, and Yamal is 19 in the last photo.

image.file: File:Remigius van Leemput (d. 1675) - Henry VII, Elizabeth of York, Henry VIII and Jane Seymour - RCIN 405750 - Royal Collection.jpg

links.line: In 1537, Holbein painted Henry VII standing behind his son, Henry VIII.
In 1570, a woodcut showed Henry VIII enthroned above Pope Clement VII.

links.line: In 2026, Pope Leo arrived in Madrid and met Spain's King Felipe.
And that July, King Felipe hugged World Cup champion Lamine Yamal.
